launch_sessions NOT TAKEN UP pickup flake when spawn already succeeded.

Duplicate doer spawned when NOT TAKEN UP fires: launch_next has no guard to detect an already-running doer for the same session before opening a second window. Fix: check for a live doer process matching the session resume ID before spawning, and surface a clear status rather than a second window.
